base_info.description: CGLS LC100 discrete class at 100 m, 20 shrubs, 30 herbaceous vegetation, 40 cropland, 50 urban, 60 bare and sparse vegetation, 70 snow and ice, 80 permanent water, 90 herbaceous wetland, 100 moss and lichen, 200 open sea, closed forest 111 evergreen needleleaf, 112 evergreen broadleaf, 113 deciduous needleleaf, 114 deciduous broadleaf, 115 mixed, 116 unknown, and open forest 121 to 126 in the same order. Classes marked filled in flag_pft have no BADM PFT, and their PFT comes from the other class of the product, then the datasets in rs_fill, and then pft_path.

PFT.nameLong: Most frequent LC100 class within 1 km of the site from 2015 to 2019, with the nearest year outside that range

PFT_grid.nameLong: LC100 class of the 100 m grid cell holding the site from 2015 to 2019, with the nearest year outside that range

PFT_merged.nameLong: BADM PFT of the site from pft_path, filled with the most frequent LC100 class within 1 km where the csv has none
PFT_merged.description: IGBP number, 1 ENF, 2 EBF, 3 DNF, 4 DBF, 5 MF, 6 CSH, 7 OSH, 8 WSA, 9 SAV, 10 GRA, 11 WET, 12 CRO, 13 URB, 14 CVM, 15 SNO, 16 BSV, 17 WAT. The PFT of the site in pft_path on every time step. Sites missing from the csv or with a PFT that is not an IGBP class, such as TBD, take the most frequent LC100 class within 1 km of each year as its BADM PFT, When that class has no BADM PFT, the class of the grid cell holding the site is used, and years with neither take the nearest year that has one.
